orientation.mirror: Exactly once in DinoAvatarRenderer, after material recoloring. Pixel centre x maps to width-1-x; normalized u maps to 1-u.
orientation.clockReadability: Unnumbered ivory dials; neutral ticks, glass and hands protected.

materials.bandana: Red diagonal sash and gold clock bezels, rings and hanging loops, each with its own reference tone.
materials.spikes: Segmented red frill, gold border, cream edge tips and red nose horn.
materials.body: Orange skin, darker spots, arms, palms and tail.
materials.belly: Cream chin, belly, brow horns, claws and underside of tail.
materials.maskMethod: Pose-specific geometry, connected ivory dial contours, protected facial details, source material islands and local categorical edge cleanup. Separate color-independent mask cache. Unpremultiply sRGB before recoloring, then premultiply; source alpha retained.

preparedArchive.format: 24 source-resolution label planes, little-endian run-length encoding (count UInt32, material UInt8). Runtime colors and source alpha remain separate.

recovery.purpose: Two measured grounded recovery stages replace the old approximately 100px push-up-to-idle eye jump. Palms stay planted in the low stage; hands release in the high stage.

import.gridRounding: Round each shared cell boundary independently. Never auto-fit individual cells.
import.alphaCleanup: Retain dominant connected silhouette at alpha >=128 and its attached antialias skirt. Discard outside low-alpha noise. Restore generated near-opaque interiors to opaque in sRGB. No painted backdrop; preserve final source alpha at runtime. Deep source-contour interiors are made fully opaque; only enclosed defects of at most 16 source pixels are repaired. Open negative spaces remain transparent.
import.extractionVariants: Built-in extraction was tried on all three sheets; originals with deterministic connected silhouette cleanup retained the exact drawings best.

rig.coordinates: 512px top-left source coordinates, scaled by pixel-centre normalization for 1254px opening. No jungle coordinates.
rig.geometry: DinoSpriteColorRenderer.VolcanoRig in Dino/Core/DinoAvatarMask.swift; each pose owns clock rectangles, hand exclusions, head contour, face and horn regions.
rig.opening: Both opening and small idle derive from the same canonical source and framing. A single detailed 1254px drawing throughout the native welcome; no sprite-cell enlargement.
